name: AutoVitals
desc:
Customer Support Specialist (Tier 1) | $24.00-$26.44/hr | Phone and Ticket Support, No Sales Expectations
Company: AutoVitals
Industry: Software (SaaS) / Auto Repair Shop Technology
What Your Day Will Look Like: AutoVitals makes software for auto repair shops, and you’d be the first person a shop reaches when they have a question or a problem with it. You’d take phone calls and work through a steady stream of support tickets, helping with everyday things like how to use a feature, find a setting, add a user, or get back into an account. When a problem is bigger than the basics, you’d decide which team should handle it (process and setup issues go to Tier 2, technical and integration issues go to Tier 3) and pass it along with clear notes so nobody has to start over. You’d log every interaction, hit response and resolution time targets, and flag spots where the help articles are confusing so they can be fixed. It’s about solving the common problems fast and knowing when to hand off the hard ones.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
Required Experience: 1+ years in customer service, technical support, help desk, or a similar customer-facing role.
Preferred Experience: SaaS support experience. Exposure to the automotive or service industry. Familiarity with AI tools or comfort using AI assistants for research and documentation.
Required Skills:
Strong written and verbal communication
Comfort following documented processes and using ticketing tools
Ability to learn new software and product concepts quickly
Good judgment about what kind of ticket it is and where it should go
Curious, self-starting, and motivated to find answers
Eligible to work in the United States
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with a year or more in customer service or help desk who wants to move into software support
Someone who stays patient and clear when a customer is frustrated
Someone who writes tidy notes so the next person can pick up where they left off
Someone interested in how auto shops run, or who likes learning a new software product
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone with no customer service or help desk experience, since a year is required
Anyone who wants a purely phone-based job, since tickets are a big part of the day
Anyone who dislikes documenting every interaction in detail
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Tier 1 customer support
Help desk and ticketing systems
Ticket triage and routing
Multi-channel support (phone, email, chat)
Account and user access troubleshooting
Detailed ticket documentation
Escalation to specialized teams
Response and resolution time targets
Knowledge base feedback
SaaS customer support
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your customer service or help desk experience and the ticketing systems you’ve used.
Walk us through how you’d help a customer who can’t log in to their account.
How do you decide when a problem needs to go to another team instead of handling it yourself?
How do you write ticket notes so the next person can pick up right where you left off?
Tell us about a time you had to learn a new piece of software quickly.
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $24.00 to $26.44/hr, confirmed in posting. Pay is set based on location, skills, education, and experience.
Shift: Full-time, hourly. Hours and time zone are not stated in the posting, confirm directly. They want someone to start immediately.
Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision, a Flexible Spending Account, 401(k) match, and flexible paid time off.
Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: This is one of the better paying remote support jobs that has come through, and the benefits include a 401(k) match and flexible PTO. The posting names Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4 teams, so there’s a clear ladder of support levels to grow into. No state list is given, so confirm Oklahoma eligibility with the recruiter. They’re looking for someone to start right away, so participants should apply soon. A help desk or ticketing system background is the strongest thing to put on the resume.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting, though it describes Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4 support teams. Reasonable inferred path: Customer Support Specialist (Tier 1) → Tier 2 Support Specialist → Tier 3 Technical Support Specialist → Support Team Lead, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by AutoVitals directly.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
